match.reason: No point in the bank teaches global branding; the closest one, on local, national and global businesses, only sorts businesses by where they operate and says nothing about using one brand worldwide.

draft.title: Global branding
card: Global branding means a business uses the same brand name, logo and image in every country it sells in.
It can save money. One set of designs and one campaign can be reused in many markets, so the business does not pay to create a new brand each time.
It can build recognition. A customer who sees the same logo at home and overseas may know the brand at once and may trust it more.
A global brand is about the brand's identity, such as its name, logo and image. Other choices, such as what the product contains or what it costs, are separate decisions.
draft.remember: One brand identity everywhere can cut costs and make the brand easier to recognise.

a.q: Which of these is an example of global branding?
opts: A shoe maker uses one name and logo in every country
A shoe maker sets a different price in each country
A shoe maker sells only through its own website
A shoe maker gives each country its own brand name
a.why: Global branding is the use of one brand name, logo and image across countries. Setting different prices is a separate decision about price, and it says nothing about whether the brand identity is the same.
a.clue: Look for the option where the brand identity stays the same.

b.q: Tane's Australian snack company sells in six countries under one name and logo. Which is the most likely benefit of this choice?
opts: It can reuse one advertising design in each market
It will be able to charge the same price everywhere
It guarantees that sales will rise in every market
It removes the need for any market research overseas
b.why: With one brand, the same designs and campaign can be reused, which cuts the cost of creating new ones. Price is a separate decision, and one brand does not guarantee sales or remove the need to research markets.
b.clue: Think about what the business no longer has to create for each country.

a.best: A shoe maker uses one name and logo in every country

b.best: It can reuse one advertising design in each market
